However, since she was not appointed by the goddess, she received opposition from the believers. In the end, could she overcome the many difficulties and realize her dream?

notes.title: "Wings of Seduction : Bust 'em out!" - New Character Reveal!!
notes.content:
[h3][b]"Captain... my face is not down there, you know?"[/b][/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38757594/a2f2d4d0c449fadb4553afc521ac03e7a68b2124.jpg[/img]


[b][h3]Character Introduction:[/h3][/b]
New Member - [b]Elise[/b] Appears!
As the brain of the team, she always demonstrates crucial strategic abilities in battles and is a trusted member of the team.
Besides her excellent intellect, she also possesses extremely outstanding long legs!
"Captain! Have you understood the briefing for this mission?..."
"Step on me! I mean... understood!"


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455140/_/


[b][h3]Development Journal:[/h3][/b]
[b][We hope our game is more than just an erotic game.][/b]

This was a core idea in our early development, aiming to create a game rich in gameplay. We are dedicated to creating good game mechanics and a core experience. Therefore, during the development process, we paid special attention to the design of the core mechanics. We delved into the sources of fun in survival games and reconstructed a unique core gameplay for "Wings of Seduction."

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38757594/7da85fbf07b97ce4b91eef251550d7342d9c4082.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38757594/17e7cdf431374048ebf3a95824297dcd6625b96a.jpg[/img]

In the process, due to continuous reflection on what players need, there were always many adjustments and modifications. We also added some systems that were not originally planned. We did all this because of the studio's belief: "Players can sense when you are not sincere." We hope to provide the best possible experience in the areas we can control.

Surprisingly, during the process, even we developers, who are most prone to getting tired of the game, still enjoy it every time we test it. This gives us more confidence to keep fighting.

Finally, after countless sleepless nights, we completed the initial full version, which contains much more content than we originally estimated. We look forward to meeting you on July 19th and letting you experience our meticulously crafted "Wings of Seduction."

Ramen Cat Studio - Lighthouse

notes.title: "Wings of Seduction : Bust 'em out!" - New Character Reveal!!
notes.content:
[h3][b]“Does the captain think I'm cute? …No negative responses allowed!”[/b][/h3]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38757594/b4d3f95996d4c30e96619a03b0def2347c1b4b00.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Character Introduction:[/h3][/b]
Introducing the new member—[b]Zara[/b]!
For machinery, what could be more important than maintenance? As the team’s professional mechanic, Zara is both skilled and passionate about various "hands-on operations" with "firearms and devices."

But be careful, if you utter any disrespectful remarks about the Institute's Chief Cat, it's hard to guarantee whether the next target of her wrench will be your plane or your head!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455140/_/

[b][h3]Development Journal:[/h3][/b]
The release date is getting closer. To provide players with an enhanced gaming experience, I continue to make improvements and add features based on feedback from the demo version. During this period, I've not only added many features according to the original plan but also included many functionalities requested by players and redesigned the breakthrough effects of weapons at full level.

Doing so much extra work within the limited original time frame is all to ensure a better player experience. While I dare not claim our game is outstanding, I truly hope players enjoy playing it.

I once heard a saying, "When a game stops updating, that's when it dies." Because I agree with this perspective, I will do my utmost to optimize and update the game after its release. There are always some ideas that could not be implemented on time due to scheduling, and I want to complete them in sequence in the future so that the game gains wider recognition.

Thank you to everyone who has provided feedback and support.

Ramen Cat Studio - Lighthouse

notes.title: 【Lewd Formosa】Escape Dungeon II - Shunral the Silver Wolf" has been released!!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/857248766358977c77754e515061559a6858a120.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309000/

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/246351f5ef8831c6ad56f0a2c4ac61323a8f6057.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/9f2f927e9d5e7e11586fb6df542c8defec4a2f8c.jpg[/img]

Story
Demon Lord Qaron had defeated the Sundista Kingdom in his war of conquest. While the Queen, with her valuable time-reversal skill, remained missing, Sundista's most powerful mage Shalith was captured and locked deep inside the dungeons. Despite their losses, those loyal to the Kingdom have not yet given up hope.
Among the resistance, there is one individual whose name alone strikes fear in every demon and monster: Shunral the Silver Wolf. This elven assassin, known for eliminating countless demons and monsters, is now determined to infiltrate the Demon Lord's castle, assassinate Lord Qaron, and bring an end to their subjugation!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/341a904c101e9a8f06610955ed752fe9bfd12fbf.jpg[/img]

"Escape Dungeon II - Shunral the Silver Wolf" is a turn-based rogue-lite that improves on the mechanics of the first game. Infiltrate the Demon Lord's castle and use your bow to defeat randomly generated monsters. Collect resources, learn abilities, and craft your loadout. Experience an immersive, yet different story with each playthrough!

Features:
- Enjoy the action with the 30+ animated & interactive Live2D "action" scenes. Each scene is three times the size of a normal CG, which allows you to magnify, move around, and examine every detail!
- Experience every dungeon and every playthrough differently with this game's rogue-lite gameplay mechanics.
- Discover and use more than 20 different special abilities to evade and eliminate your enemies!
- Unlock CGs using an alternative method. You don't have to lose on purpose every time!
- Immerse yourself in the story with a fully-voiced main character.
- Help yourself out with the built-in resource assistant. No mods or cheat programs are required!
